Definition
[The Type III limsup scale] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0260 1. Equation 8.23\group dilations-of-infinite-time-singularities

For a Type III solution on $[0,\infty )$, define \[ \alpha \coloneqq \limsup _{t\to \infty }\left(t\sup _{\mathcal M^n}|\Rm (\cdot ,t)|\right)\in [0,\infty ). \]
